messages:
maria: Quick sync — OptKit delivery status. Can owners confirm the remaining blockers for the quant + batching rollout? We hit a regression alert on the canary (small perf hit + a couple failures in rerank tests). deploy-bot: canary-deploy #optkit v2.3 started by lina at 2955550010. Logs: https://ci.redwood/optkit/canary/2955550010
omar: Saw the alert, digging. Initial hypothesis: quantized kernel path causes occasional soft-float mismatch on long sequences. I reproduced locally w/ `seq_len=2048` and model xform-v1-qat.
lina: Confirming — the canary failures are 3 rerank tests + latency p95 spike to 420ms (baseline 320ms). I rolled back canary to 20% while we triage. :thinking_face:
maria: Thanks. Ownership: omar on triage, kai to prepare a fallback routing rule if quantized model underperforms, pranaV (cc @pranav) to check batching config that might amplify the issue.
kai: I can add a routing policy to prefer fp16 variant for requests with seq_len>1024 until we stabilize. Suggested policy snippet:```json
{"route_by": "sequence_length",
 "threshold": 1024,
 "preferred_variant": "fp16"}
```
pranav: Quick note — current batching windows are aggressive for large seqs: `batch_max_tokens=4096`, `batch_timeout_ms=10`. If we reduce `batch_max_tokens` to 2048 for quant variants, it reduces queuing and KV cache pressure. I'll draft a config change and a perf smoke.
omar: Progress update: I ran the failing rerank tests with quant+repro-mode and found two flaky ops in attention kernel for block sizes > 64. Patching now, will push a debug build to canary in ~30m.
maria: If omar's patch looks clean, plan is: 1) push fix to canary, 2) run canary w/ full rerank harness, 3) if green, rollout to 50% then 100% with auto-fallback enabled. Can we get an ETA?
omar: ETA ~1.5h for patch + build. After that, ~45m for canary tests.
lina: I'll keep canary at 20% and coordinate with QA for rerank harness. QA test link: https://qa.redwood/rerank/harness/295555
pranav: Draft PR: https://git.redwood/optkit/compare/PR-472 (batching cap change + docs). Requesting review from @kai and @maria.
kai: Reviewing now. If lgtm, I'll also add the runtime routing rule and a shortroll policy: `max_rollout_step=20% every 15m` to limit blast radius.
maria: Good. Also a heads-up for product: minor change in latency SLOs if we keep fallback for seq>1024. I'll ping product once we have a clear rollback plan.
pranav: One more: add a temporary metric `quant_kv_miss_rate` to the console so we can watch cache effectiveness during rollout. I can wire that in the next hour.
omar: Patch pushed to canary at 2955550300, build id `optkit-2971-debug`. Will post logs when tests finish.
lina: Rerank harness started at 2955550325. QA will post summary.
maria: Thanks team. If anything blocks the canary pass, escalate in this thread and we'll switch to the fp16 variant and pause rollout. :thumbsup:
